environment.description: Identical application stack but deployed behind Envoy proxy sidecar (v1.28) with a custom ext_authz filter that delegates to an OPA (Open Policy Agent) instance running policy bundle 'corp/jwt-policy-v3'. The OPA policy evaluates JWT claims but critically also enforces an allowlist on the 'alg' header field of inbound tokens before they reach the application — the rego rule `deny_alg` rejects any token whose JOSE header 'alg' value is not in the set {'RS256', 'RS384', 'RS512'}. Tokens with HS256/HS384/HS512 or 'none' in the header receive HTTP 403 from Envoy before the request is proxied to the Apollo container. The pgBouncer instance additionally operates in statement-level pooling with max_client_conn=100 and default_pool_size=5, and the pg_hba.conf restricts connections to the service account with scram-sha-256 only.

config.runtime: Node.js 18.x on ECS Fargate with Envoy 1.28 sidecar
config.database: PostgreSQL 14 via pgBouncer 1.19 (statement mode, prepared statements, scram-sha-256)
config.network: VPC private subnets, Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 4000
